title: Pal Rap Back
style: Alternative R&B with dembow bounce, clap-heavy percussion, swung half-time groove, and a fast switch-up into Russian rap phrasing; verse rides minimal drums and sub pulses, pre-chorus stacks high kid-like vocal layers, chorus hits with gang claps and a chopped hook. Vocal is close-mic with airy doubles, playful ad-libs, and quick delay throws on key phrases. Ear candy: reversed swells into drops, phone-filter vox, rim-click pickups. Bright, glossy, club-ready mix with punchy low end., alternative r&b, bounce, latin, rap

[Verse 1]
africans lyrics only
clap and rap song
I bring the hands up
Then I bring the tongue

rappal.app
rap pal dot app
you got that?
sing it back pal

rap back
wanna dance pal
dance latin america pal
move in the dust, then laugh

go to pal dot dance
feet on the floor now
alternative r&b
turn the whole room out

high vocals kid computer voces
small voice, big echo
be my song pal
and don’t let go

song pal
